eligibility.quote: I forgot that I had specific DDS setting in my `~/.bashrc` (`FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE`), based on the accepted answer of https://answers.ros.org/question/370595/ros2-foxy-nodes-cant-communicate-through-docker-container-border/ ... By removing that specific config and by re-running the test above, I have now similar results than with ROS1

notes: Resolving change was the removal of user shell environment variable configuration FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE; no unit interface changed.
